notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}
When Cult Conscript dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
